# Why this section exists

Training a model is only half the work. The other half is asking, honestly: how well does it do, on data it has not seen, and by which measure?

# What will live here

Pages I intend to write, not pages that exist today:

- Train, validation and test splits — why we hold data back.
- Metrics that match the problem (accuracy is not always the right number).
- Overfitting and underfitting, in pictures before formulas.
- Cross-validation, when the dataset is small.
- How evaluation changes when we move from classic models to deep networks and then to language models.

Nothing above is written yet. When a page appears, this outline will shrink and the sidebar will grow.
